name: maildoc
description: The MailDoc — the doctor for your domain's email

scripts.test: pnpm run check:brands && pnpm run check:tokens && turbo run test
scripts.ship: turbo run build && pnpm run check:brands && pnpm run check:tokens && turbo run test && pnpm --filter @maildoc/web exec wrangler deploy
scripts.domains: pnpm --filter @maildoc/web exec wrangler tail --format json --method GET | jq -r --unbuffered 'select(.event.request.url | test("/api/(check|spf/ip|lookup|flatten|bimi)")) | [(.eventTimestamp/1000 | todate), (.event.request.url | capture("domain=(?<d>[^&]*)").d), (.event.request.url | capture("/api/(?<t>[a-z/]+)").t)] | @tsv'
scripts.db:migrate:checkups: pnpm --filter @maildoc/web exec wrangler d1 execute maildoc-leads --remote --file=migrations/0002_create_checkups.sql
